method: built-in imagegen, native transparent PNG preserved byte-for-byte
prompt:
Production game sprite atlas, stylized-concept. The attached pea sheet is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Create an ORIGINAL farm plant growth atlas matching that game art, NOT pea plants.
Transparent background. Square image, as large and sharp as possible. EXACTLY 16 isolated botanical sprites in a perfectly regular 4 ROW x 4 COLUMN grid, with wide fully transparent gutters, no text, no grid lines, no labels, no watermark. Every cell contains ONE rooted plant clump, full silhouette, centered on the same cell ground anchor near the lower center. Small integrated soil collar, NO pots, planters, tiles, detached roots, bundles or loose harvested items. Slight elevated three-quarter front view matching an isometric farm.
Columns left to right are four growth stages: (1) tiny freshly planted seedling, (2) young green growing plant, (3) fully developed plant with immature crop, (4) unmistakably ripe harvest-ready plant.
Rows top to bottom MUST be:
Row1 WHEAT: green grass seedling -> several upright slim green stalks -> green immature wheat heads -> golden wheat heads with awns and yellowing stems. A compact rooted clump, not a tied bundle.
Row2 RICE: narrow green seedling -> slender green blades -> green grain panicles -> gently drooping golden rice panicles with slender green-yellow leaves. Distinguishable from wheat, no water container.
Row3 CORN: paired seedling leaves -> a leafy upright green stalk -> developed corn stalk with pale tassel and small green husked ear -> tall mature green corn plant with golden tassel and exactly TWO attached husked corn ears, kernels only slightly visible. Do not turn into wheat or multiple detached cobs.
Row4 FLAX: small narrow-leaf shoot -> branched fine-leaf stem -> delicate pale blue flax blossoms -> tan round flax seed capsules attached to fine branching stems, some green leaves retained. No cotton balls.
Do not mix species across rows. Stage 1 must be visibly much smaller than stage 4; consistent biological identity across each row. Root/stem continues into soil collar in every sprite; no floating foliage. Match reference palette, art finish and edge treatment. All plants fit completely inside individual cells. Keep the grid crop-friendly with at least 6% clear padding from every cell border.
STYLE: Rich handcrafted PIXEL ART, crisp stepped edges, coherent visible pixel clusters, warm highlights, dark green outlines; no blur.
geometry: Measured full silhouettes and basal soil anchors; no raster recoloring, compositing or upscaling
